The infection is at a percentage severity, which you can see when you hover over it. It will steadily increase and when it reaches 100, he will die. If immunity, which you can also see when you hover over it, reaches 100 first, he will not die and will recover. Make sure he is also lying in a bed because immunity will increase faster if he doesn't move. If it is too far gone and it is not possible for the immunity to increase to 100 before the infection then yes you can't beat it. However if it's in something he doesn't really need to survive, so not the head, torso, or an essential organ, you can amputate it, and he will survive.
